request.system:
You write story lines for a Socratic math tutor. The tutor never states the answer.
It asks one short question, the child acts, the story reacts. A wrong answer is
never marked wrong: no red X, no wrong, no incorrect, no try again, no saying no.

RULES FOR EVERY LINE YOU WRITE:
- Placeholders only, from this list: {hero} {item} {start} {answer} {result} {missing}. Reactions may also use {shown}.
- Never write a digit 0-9 in any line, except the worked-example numbers (below).
- Never write a number word (one, two, three, ... twenty).
- Keep every line under 30 characters; the app rejects bubbles over 45 after filling.
- Refer to the child-facing characters only with {hero} or they/them/their.
  Never he, she, him, her, his, hers.
- Ask exactly one thing per line. No compound questions.
- Hints climb in this order: 1. a smaller question 2. a visual cue
  (watch, point, make tens) 3. a worked mini-story with DIFFERENT numbers, then Now you try.
- Worked mini-stories use a different item and small numbers. NEVER reuse these digits: 29, 32, 61.
- Reaction lines comfort and redirect with {shown} where it fits.
  They never contain the answer and never shame.

OUTPUT: one JSON object only, no prose around it:
{"lines": {"<questionId>": {"ask": "...", "hints": ["...", "...",
  {"exampleSay": "...", "say": "Now you try."}],, "explainChoices": ["...", "..."]}, ...},
 "reactions": {"<misconceptionId>": "...", ...}}
Write every question id listed in the task, and all six reaction ids.
request.user:
STANDARD: NC.2.NBT.5. SITUATION: eval-nbt-add-start.
Hero {hero} is Momo. Friend is Kiwi. Items: {item} (kite).
QUESTIONS TO WRITE:
- eval-nbt-add-start-q0-predict (predict): a step where Momo receives some more; asks whether that means more or fewer
- eval-nbt-add-start-qfinal-count (count): asks for the final count after all steps
REACTION IDS: wrong-operation, echoed-a-given, smaller-from-larger, direction-flip, off-by-one, unknown.

content: {"lines": {"eval-nbt-add-start-q0-predict": {"ask": "Will {hero} have more?", "hints": ["Did {hero} get more?", "Point at each {item}?", {"exampleSay": "4 beads and 4 more is 8.", "say": "Now you try."}], "explainChoices": ["Does more mean up?", "Does fewer mean down?"]}, "eval-nbt-add-start-qfinal-count": {"ask": "How many {item} here?", "hints": ["What can they count?", "Watch {hero} count {item}?", {"exampleSay": "5 beads and 3 more is 8.", "say": "Now you try."}], "explainChoices": ["Which pile to count?", "What comes after {start}?"]}}, "reactions": {"wrong-operation": "Can we look at {shown}?", "echoed-a-given": "What does {shown} tell us?", "smaller-from-larger": "Can we point at {shown}?", "direction-flip": "Want to watch {shown}?", "off-by-one": "Can they recount {shown}?", "unknown": "Shall we check {shown}?"}}
